capabilities: Edit maps using keyboard, mouse, or touch.
disambiguation: It transforms a standard Markdown note into a visual, interactive mind map structure.
extras: The AI agent skill is provided separately and is not part of the plugin release.
intentEvidence: Open a note as a keyboard-first mind map and edit it in place.
problem: Standard Markdown notes are static and difficult to visualize or rearrange hierarchically during brainstorming or planning.

relations.evidence: Several Obsidian plugins open a Markdown note as a mind map you can edit.
The others also do things Mindslate doesn't: Rich Mindmap adds priority, progress and flag marks to nodes; linkmind, OMM MindMap and Stratify Mindmap export a map as an image

summary: Mindslate transforms Markdown notes into interactive, keyboard-first mind maps that allow in-place editing while preserving the original note structure.
